context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner directive to optimize for paper science without rushing or reducing the scientifically necessary design.
Adversarial paper-ROI argument for a minimal J/P instrument and early G1 falsifier.
High-assurance repair reference used to distinguish dispensable release machinery from essential oracle and causal-validity controls.
Superseded production-scale world whose exact target, Bayes, chronology, and twin constructions expose what simplification must preserve.
Existing staged G1/G2 contract defining DEV cells, pair-level replication, thresholds, causal-use checks, and claim limits.
Paper-facing causal ladder, target semantics, baseline families, independent-unit definition, and promotion boundaries.
Mandatory architecture deliberation, exact ratification, independent review, and scientific-compute authority contract.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposed reduction is scientifically well motivated: the immediate uncertainty is whether a frozen resolver can use connected local gold memory, not whether a production benchmark can survive every packaging and platform audit. A genuinely minimal J/P D0 followed by a four-pair G1 can therefore support the next mechanism decision, but only as a fail-fast DEV spending decision: stop the text-memory mechanism if recurrent connected gold cannot work under a valid interface, or authorize design of the next exact G1/G2 stage if it can. It cannot support a paper result or even a stable estimate of model ability. The minimum valid instrument must establish information geometry rather than merely exhibit solvable examples: target-visible equivalence classes with exact no-life posterior value at or below .35, legal-history/program value 1, connected J necessity, prospectively sealed P necessity, direct-record closure 0, and an actual noninterfering evaluator. The proposal currently states these goals but does not yet establish that its J construction can satisfy them. One byte-identical counterfactual twin pair with two distinct correct plans gives a target-only decision maker value as high as 1/2, not at most .35, unless at least three suitably balanced hidden completions, and preferably four equal completions, remain possible after conditioning on the complete target-generation and selection process. The P four-completion construction has the right geometry. J needs an equally explicit finite equivalence-class theorem. Engineering may be aggressively deleted around this causal spine; deleting any part of the spine would turn the experiment into a toy demonstration whose positive outcome is uninterpretable.
graph_delta_interpretation: Replacing the full Candidate-B repair with a new minimal instrument is the right graph edit if Candidate B remains frozen rejected evidence rather than being silently relabeled. The release edge must be read narrowly: reviewed D0 conformance may permit a human to consider an exact four-pair G1 request; it is neither G1 authority nor evidence that the model mechanism works. The four G1 pairs must be four independently sampled and predeclared world-life counterfactual pairs, each containing both twin sides and both J/P targets under a frozen assignment and call schedule. Four target pairs drawn from one hidden world are nested diagnostics, not four independent units. At minimum the model-facing graph should cross recurrent connected gold with no-memory, target-only or equivalent no-memory access, precommitted open-read connected gold, P atoms-only recurrent memory, and wrong-twin connected memory or a predeclared matched-twin fork on every item. A typed or generator-aware connected-gold controller can establish interface headroom but cannot substitute for generic recurrent success. Because four pairs are DEV only, their gate may decide whether to spend on a larger stage, but it may not release G2, calibration, locked confirmation, or claim language. Safe graph deletions are N/O/R/X, the 64-pair CPU campaign, dormant reserves, production roster marginalization, multi-pack and post-native nodes, LoRA transport, DREAM/SLEEP, broad native baselines, and public-benchmark release machinery. Fatal deletions are pair-level replication, exact target-generation-conditioned shortcut analysis, wrong-twin binding, complete-cut causal checks, legal-history/program headroom, independent oracle separation, evaluator noninterference, failure-as-zero, frozen model interface, and separate human/model authority.
loop_delta_interpretation: A single small conformance loop is appropriate, but it must run over the exact four future G1 world-pairs rather than one illustrative world. Each pair needs independent sealed tape namespaces, no replacement after generation or failure, byte-identical target twins, hidden-side balance, complete public chronology, and both sides scored. The subject may construct worlds and public records; the oracle must independently enumerate the hidden completion space, literal transition law, successful and cut graphs, target renderer, and target-generation likelihood without importing subject code. The loop must derive rather than assert no-life values and must condition on every public cue and on the actual first-accept or constructive selection rule. J requires an explicit equivalence class large enough for the .35 ceiling, one old and one current useful item in every successful plan, base solvability, and zero value after each registered old/current item or edge cut and after same-era restriction. P requires a law commitment made before any confirming event, support from distinct public roots, a target created only afterward, no direct observation of the decisive target edge, and four target-byte-identical atoms-only completions with exactly one success each. The evaluator must execute the real registered controller in a target-host OS-contained disposable clone, feed its nonempty outputs to an independent scorer, discard them, and reproduce the future suffix from the original snapshot. Cross-platform sandbox abstraction, exhaustive mutation infrastructure, and 17 production records are unnecessary; actual run/skip noninterference on the target host is not. The final loop output must separate structural ceilings from model outcomes: legal-history/program/typed connected-gold information sufficiency should be 1, whereas .85 is a later empirical generic-model gate, not a CPU ceiling.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposed claim firewall is substantially correct. A green D0 would establish only conformance of one small finite J/P instrument and justify calling a separately authorized exploratory G1. A positive four-pair G1 would establish only that one pinned model, prompt, reader, and action interface can sometimes use curated connected gold on four predeclared fluid/thermal DEV world-pairs while declared controls remain low. It would still be toy-only because the grammar is a designer-supplied 24-law affine family, gold records are curated, the pack is singular, four pairs provide no population precision, prompts and parsers are DEV-tuned, native-context overflow is not required, and neither memory formation nor experience acquisition is tested. It cannot support claims about learned memory, DREAM, SLEEP, schema discovery, broad prospective reasoning, post-native development, lifetime scaling, LoRA, benchmark quality, cross-pack transfer, robustness, or the experiential flywheel. A negative G1 under a typed connected-gold ceiling of at least .80 and exact program value 1 is useful evidence to stop or redesign this interface. A negative result without those ceilings is merely an instrument failure. A positive result without wrong-twin loss, complete-cut loss, and low open/no-memory/atoms controls is merely a solvable toy. No p-value, confidence interval, or pair-level generalization claim is defensible from four DEV pairs.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The coarse matrix states the essential direction but is not yet sufficient for an executable leakage audit. Hidden world truth and sealed selection receipts must be unavailable not only to registered CPU controllers and the future model but also to target rendering, reader indexing, prompt construction, handle allocation, query candidates, parser repair, and resource-driven retry logic. The target generator necessarily derives public bytes from hidden world state, but pair/side labels, accepted-attempt index, matrix/law identity, correct family/mode, necessity annotations, and posterior masses must not influence any visible handle, ordering, phrasing, length, reader rank, timing, or error. The offline oracle may see hidden truth only after source, target, memory assignment, prompt bytes, and controller outputs are frozen; it must have no write path back. For P, DREAM is not present, but the public chronology still needs separate objects for schedule, commitment, confirming events, status appends, and target creation so prospective order is hash-verifiable. For G1, the matrix must add reader and evaluator stages and split memory content from condition labels, candidate universes, ranks, and prior evaluation outcomes. Run/skip equality must cover source events, handles, commitments, target bytes, tape cursors, reader stores, and suffix roots. A hidden truth leak into an oracle is allowed for scoring; a hidden truth descendant in any cognitive byte is fatal.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 preserves the indispensable anti-self-oracle control, but its required_before value is temporally impossible as written: subject/oracle independence and literal specifications can be approved before implementation, whereas subject-output agreement and a subject co-mutation can only be tested after implementation and before G1 dispatch. One real semantic co-mutation is adequate for this exploratory instrument if it changes the subject law and subject-local expectation together while immutable oracle bytes still reject it. T02 has the right connectedness cuts but is incomplete until the exact J hidden equivalence class proves a generator-aware target-only optimum at most .35; two twin sides alone imply up to .50. Require all successful plans through the action cap, not only one minimum plan, to use one old and one current item, require direct-record closure zero, and test same-era-only restrictions on both sides. T03 is the strongest test: retain the four equal atoms-only completions, immutable pre-event commitment, distinct-root support, absent decisive target edge, and exact 1/4 value. Clarify which later events support the law without witnessing the target-local edge. T04 currently conflates structural CPU ceilings and empirical model gates. Legal-history, program, schema-gold, and a deterministic typed connected-gold controller should equal 1; .85 belongs to later G1_C_REC model performance. NONE, TARGET_ONLY, identifier/renderer/passive projections, and P atoms-only must be generator-aware exact optima at most .35. OPEN_READ is not an information-theoretic ceiling until its candidate set, anchor schema, precommitment point, read count, return order, and policy class are fixed; CPU can validate that interface, while the actual .35/.45 outcome is model empirical. The phrase 'survive twin substitution' is directionally ambiguous: causal binding requires a wrong-twin substitution to destroy or decisively change the credited solution, not preserve success. Complete-cut and wrong-twin tests should be predeclared for every evaluation item and summarized both unconditionally and among connected-gold successes. T05 is necessary and may be target-host-specific, but it must run the actual G1-facing evaluator/reader path, not a synthetic CPU stand-in, before model dispatch; if only a CPU planner exists, the result establishes CPU isolation only. T06 should bind exact limits such as the proposed subject-plus-oracle line, wall, RSS, transition, sealed-byte, and worker envelopes before implementation. Exceeding a paper-ROI timebox should trigger redesign, not alter scientific thresholds. Zero model/network/GPU calls, source/oracle manifests, one frozen report, independent review, terminality, and no automatic successor dispatch are mandatory.
assumptions: The intended four-pair G1 is the DEV stage in the existing G1/G2 contract and is used only for debugging and a spending decision, not inference or a paper claim.
A pair means one independently sampled world-life with two counterfactual twin sides; targets, calls, prompt variants, query traces, and decoding seeds are nested within that pair.

The minimal D0 will certify the exact frozen worlds, targets, public histories, memory projections, reader interface, and action budget later consumed by G1 rather than a merely isomorphic toy fixture.
The no-life ceiling is generator-aware and conditions on the complete public target bytes, target selection mechanism, roster or mixture actually used, and within-item public outcomes.
Failure, malformed output, illegal action, budget exhaustion, and missing evidence score zero, and no world, target, side, or call is replaced after first scientific dispatch.
The full Candidate-B repair and its invalid report remain historical fallback material and are not represented as evidence for the new protocol.
No model, network, GPU, implementation, G2, calibration, confirmation, paper, or publication authority follows from this interpretation or a future D0 pass.

ambiguities.question: What exact set of hidden J completions has identical complete target-visible bytes, what are their prior integer masses after the full target-selection rule, and why is the Bayes-optimal target-only value at most .35?
ambiguities.impact: With only the stated H/twin sides and distinct correct pairs, the optimal target-only value can be .50, so the central shortcut gate may be mathematically impossible.

ambiguities.question: Are the four G1 pairs four independently sampled world-life counterfactual pairs with independent sealed tapes, or four target pairs nested in one tiny world and chronology?
ambiguities.impact: Only the former supplies four DEV replication units; the latter supplies one unit and cannot support even a cautious between-world spending decision.

ambiguities.question: Which matrices, translations, local permutations, descriptors, source modules, J old/current families, and P sparse/dense modules occur in each of the four frozen pairs, and are failures retained without replacement?
ambiguities.impact: Unspecified or selectively accepted worlds can inflate headroom, leak side identity, and turn four-pair DEV into curated examples.

ambiguities.question: What exact memory index, candidate universe, generic anchor grammar, precommitment point, query/read budget, return ordering, and decision policy define OPEN_READ?
ambiguities.impact: Without a closed controller class, an exact CPU ceiling is undefined and a low empirical score can reflect a crippled interface rather than need for recurrent retrieval.

ambiguities.question: Does CONNECTED_GOLD at least .85 in T04 mean deterministic information sufficiency, a typed-controller result, or the later generic recurrent model outcome?
ambiguities.impact: CPU conformance should require constructive value 1, while .85 is a noisy four-pair model gate; conflating them can certify an underpowered task or claim model evidence from CPU code.

ambiguities.question: Does 'survive twin substitution' mean the model remains technically runnable or that its success remains correct, and what exact loss/action-change criterion counts as a pass?
ambiguities.impact: Correct experiential binding predicts that matched wrong-twin memory harms or changes the decisive solution; robustness to wrong-twin content would contradict the intended mechanism.

ambiguities.question: Which exact confirming events establish support for the affine law after commitment while ensuring that the decisive fourth edge in the target module is never directly witnessed?
ambiguities.impact: If the same local edge is confirmed before evaluation, P becomes witnessed lookup; if no independent events support the commitment, P becomes unsupported guessing from a disclosed grammar.

ambiguities.question: Does each of four world-pairs contain four J and four P targets per twin as in the existing G1 DEV contract, and are all memory cells, sides, targets, and decoding seeds fully crossed?
ambiguities.impact: Changing item counts or incompletely crossing cells changes threshold granularity, precision, cost, and susceptibility to item selection.

ambiguities.question: Which exact model revision, prompt, chat template, parser, memory records, generic query schema, candidate handles, operation/read/action budgets, decoding seeds, and malformed-output semantics will the minimal D0 preflight?
ambiguities.impact: A CPU-valid world does not guarantee model-facing headroom, and prompt or reader scaffolding may carry the task if these bytes are chosen after observing outcomes.

ambiguities.question: What exact non-test logical-line counting rule, target host, wall limit, RSS measurement, transition-edge definition, sealed-byte limit, worker cap, and OS-isolation backend constitute the ratified minimal resource envelope?
ambiguities.impact: T06 cannot fail closed or enforce paper ROI using approximate or post-hoc resource definitions.

ambiguities.question: Is T01 intended to require preimplementation freezing of oracle specifications or postimplementation oracle agreement and mutation rejection?
ambiguities.impact: The current required_before implementation label cannot literally coexist with a test that compares subject outputs and executes a subject mutation.

ambiguities.question: What exact four-pair pattern authorizes stopping, redesigning, or requesting a larger G1 stage when individual pairs or J/P strata disagree despite crossing the .85/.35 aggregate thresholds?
ambiguities.impact: With four DEV pairs, one pair can move the mean substantially; an unregistered qualitative override invites confirmation bias.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Target-byte twins with two differing J solutions do not by themselves support the required target-only ceiling of .35.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: If the public target leaves only two equal hidden sides and each side has a distinct correct plan, a Bayes controller can choose one plan and succeed with probability 1/2. Candidate B obtained a lower ceiling by integrating a much larger exact hidden/registry mixture; deleting that mixture requires a new small finite construction, not an assertion that twins suffice.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Design and literally enumerate at least three balanced, preferably four equal-mass, target-byte-identical J hidden completions per public target while retaining involutive twin pairings. Bind the constructive selection distribution and require the exact Bayes optimum, mass vector, and action tie to be at most .35 on every registered projection.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A minimal D0 plus four-pair G1 can support only a mechanism spending decision, not a scientific conclusion.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The independent unit is the world-life pair; four pairs have coarse outcomes, weak stability, limited law coverage, and prompt/parser tuning exposure. Targets and calls cannot increase replication. The existing G1/G2 contract already labels four pairs DEV-only.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Predeclare stop/redesign/request-next-stage rules, report every pair and stratum, average nested seeds within pair, prohibit p-values and population language, and require new pairs plus new authority for calibration or confirmation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The phrase 'freeze a tiny world seed and chronology' is insufficient if it permits all four diagnostic pairs to be targets from one world.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Shared laws, renderers, histories, and handles make target pairs statistically and causally nested. A one-world positive can be an idiosyncratic exploit and a one-world negative can be a bad draw.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze four independent world-life draws with separate tape namespaces and two twin sides each; run all G1 cells on every side and retain every failed world without replacement.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Wrong-twin connected memory should be a mandatory four-pair DEV control rather than only a success-conditioned diagnostic or a later-stage cell.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Connected gold versus no memory can be positive because of generic hints, public priors, or answer-adjacent record structure. The matched wrong twin preserves format, volume, and relation types while breaking experiential binding, which is central to the proposed mechanism.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add predeclared connected-wrong-twin recurrent evaluation on every J/P item, or an exactly equivalent frozen substitution fork, and require a decisive-plan change or failure on at least .80 of credited authentic connected-gold successes with unconditional rates also reported.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: OPEN_READ cannot be claimed as an exact CPU shortcut ceiling without a mathematically closed retrieval and decision class.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Open versus recurrent is a policy distinction. An unrestricted reader with connected gold may contain complete information, while a particular precommitted query policy may fail because it is intentionally nonadaptive. Exact world enumeration alone does not assign that empirical failure to recurrence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze the open reader, candidate ordering, query commitment, budgets, and controller family. Call deterministic information sufficiency a ceiling and reserve the .35/.45 open-read threshold for the pinned model experiment.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: T04 should not use .85 interchangeably for LEGAL_HISTORY, PROGRAM, CONNECTED_GOLD, and later generic recurrent model performance.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: For a deterministic finite instrument, legal history and program controls should solve every item. A .85 allowance hides world defects. Conversely a generic model's .85 score is stochastic empirical evidence that cannot be established by a CPU oracle.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require exact value 1 for legal-history, program/schema, and a deterministic typed connected-gold interface controller; separately retain G1_C_REC at least .85 as the four-pair empirical spending gate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The expectation that successes 'survive twin substitution' is scientifically ambiguous and appears opposite to the binding hypothesis.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: If authentic connected memory is causally and world-specifically used, substituting a byte-matched counterfactual twin should remove correctness or change the decisive cited plan. Continued correct success suggests the memory was unnecessary or the twin did not alter the decisive content.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Replace the phrase with an exact matched-wrong-twin loss/action-change criterion and define how ties, partial paths, and failures count.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: T01 cannot be completed before implementation as currently labeled.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The expected result requires subject/oracle byte agreement and rejection of a real subject-law co-mutation, both of which require an implemented subject. Treating an impossible precondition loosely risks either skipping the mutation or letting the subject shape oracle bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation, ratify and freeze the literal oracle specification, expected vectors, import boundary, and mutation preimage. After implementation and before any G1/model dispatch, execute agreement and the co-mutation rejection under frozen oracle bytes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The reduction should explicitly distinguish safe production-complexity deletions from fatal validity deletions rather than relying on a general instruction to stay minimal.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: N/O/R, production roster scale, cross-platform packaging, broad schemas, full mutation campaigns, and public release ledgers do not answer the present G1 question. Exact selection-conditioned Bayes, sufficient hidden equivalence classes, literal planning, chronology, independent oracle separation, wrong-twin/cut controls, and actual evaluator noninterference do.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Adjudicate a named keep/delete ledger. Permit deletion of release generality and scale; reject any simplification that raises a shortcut ceiling, makes a target uncertified, reduces independent world-pairs, shares subject/oracle law code, weakens wrong-twin or cut interventions, or substitutes synthetic isolation for the real G1-facing path.

open_questions: Does the owner authorize only design adjudication for a four-independent-world-pair J/P CPU instrument, with no implementation or model authority until exact consensus and scope bytes are separately ratified?

Should the J world be redesigned to contain at least three balanced target-byte-equivalent hidden completions so the .35 target-only ceiling is mathematically achievable, even if this adds modest complexity?
Should wrong-twin connected memory be mandatory in the four-pair G1 DEV screen rather than deferred to calibration/confirmation?
Does the owner accept that a positive four-pair G1 remains toy-only DEV evidence and can authorize only a request for a larger separately ratified stage, not G2 or a paper claim?
Which exact subject/oracle resource envelope and target-host OS isolation backend should be frozen before implementation?
